title: Hearing and Noise Pollution
summary: How the ear turns vibrations into signals, the decibel scale, safe listening, and India's noise rules.

ib.note: Links to MYP Individuals & Societies (urban environments)

objectives: I can describe how the ear detects sound (eardrum, ear bones, cochlea).
I can use the decibel scale and explain how loud sounds damage hearing.
I can evaluate ways to reduce noise pollution in my community.
misconceptions: Hearing loss only happens to old people.
If a sound doesn't hurt, it can't damage your ears.
Noise is just annoying, not harmful.
